dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: When did the stomach problem begin?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Two days ago. I started having diarrhea during the night.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: The evening before that, we all ate at a new restaurant.

dialogue.speaker: child
dialogue.text: You stayed in bed almost all day yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Yes. I was very tired and had stomach cramps.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: He has barely been drinking anything since yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: No. We checked several times and I did not have a fever.

dialogue.speaker: child
dialogue.text: You said your stomach hurt after drinking water too.

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Yes, drinking quickly seemed to make the cramps worse.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: Nobody else in the family has become sick yet.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Have you noticed blood in the diarrhea?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: No, there has been no blood.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: The most important thing right now is checking for dehydration. I will examine you and we will decide whether you need any additional tests.
